# Using bound service account tokens {#bound-service-account-tokens}

You can use bound service account tokens, which improve the ability to integrate with cloud provider identity access management (IAM) services such as OpenShift Container Platform on {{ aws_short }} IAM or {{ gcp_full }} IAM.
